answer: Operator accountability pool: each operator deposits collateral into a shared river contract covering every identity it runs, so one violation drains the whole pool. When a cluster is flagged, the contract slashes collateral per identity rather than freezing wallets, and a flagged operator cannot open a new terrace of identities until the debt clears. That fixed penalty — real capital lost per fake identity — makes bulk registration costly, and repeat offenses escalate into a violet lock on all future registrations by that operator.
